title: Truncate instead of dropping long retained failure lines
body:
Outcome: a failing TAP line longer than the guest failure reserve still reaches gate evidence. summaryStream.retain (infra/ci/internal/executor/guest.go) drops a single not-ok line longer than the remaining 32 KiB reserve; truncate retained lines (e.g. 1024 bytes) instead. Accepted as residual by override in PR #226 review attempt 3.
Proof: a Go receiver feeds a 40 KiB not-ok line past the head and asserts its prefix is in the log; run via test/ci/gate-evidence-failures.test.ts.
